decision_making: The completeness and compliance of submitted grant applications.
The prioritization of competing application deadlines.

duties.statement: Processes research grant applications by confirming revisions, checking budgets, and drawing attention to compliance issues.
Coordinates communication between principal investigators and external funding agencies.
Maintains accurate records of grant activity and prepares periodic reports.

jd.position_summary: The Research Grants Coordinator processes research grant applications to ensure that agency policies and guidelines have been met, and coordinates the flow of information between researchers and funding agencies.
problem_solving: Discrepancies between application budgets and agency guidelines.
Conflicting submission deadlines during peak funding periods.

qualifications.text: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and three years of related administrative experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Working knowledge of research grant administration and Tri-Agency guidelines.
Intermediate skills in spreadsheet and database applications.
Ability to interpret and apply complex policies and guidelines.

external: Corresponds with federal and provincial granting agencies.
internal: Liaises with faculty researchers and departmental finance staff.
relationships.supervisory: Supervision Received: Works under the general direction of the Manager, Research Services.
